about_the_game:
About the demo

In this demo, you will escape the android slave factory, travel across an abandoned warehouse and take a peek at the vibrant Synth City. During your adventure, you will learn the first core mechanics of the game and learn a bit about the world of Synthetic Hopes!

Demo features

  • 45 puzzles to solve using the first mechanics of the game,

  • Two environments to discover as well as the firsts pieces of music of the original soundtrack,

  • Most of the main game options, including a colorblind mode for those that have difficulties differentiating some colors.

  • A demo completion time, so that you can compare your wits to your friends'!

About the game
Synthetic Hopes is a puzzle game with original and systemic mechanics sparkled with a few platforming action sequences. In a cyberpunk world where androids have been reduced to slavery, you are a first-generation model that finally has a shot at freedom.

Escape the lights to advance. Pickup and combine elements to create new mixtures. Clear obstacles and create paths where there is none. Learn the ways of the world and maybe you’ll have a chance to break the cycle!
